title: Space Station Zap
description: Builds and draws a random space-station map of rooms, walls, doors, and shields. The monsters, keys, and weapons its comments plan were not written.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: Space Station Zap (blocks 74-78)
versions.note: Source blocks copied unchanged from the New Programs disk. The player boots the Forth System disk and loads them with the original commands. Checked to its first screen only.
versions.running: Running MMSFORTH from the original disks

attribution.text: From my 1982 MMSFORTH disks. My friend and roommate Rich Losey may have contributed. Runs on MMSFORTH V2.0, © 1981 Miller Microcomputer Services. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.

howTo: It builds and draws a new station while it starts, which took a few minutes on the real machine, so the player runs that part fast. Then it keeps working out doors, and a counter runs at the top of the screen. There is no gameplay. Restart draws another station.
quickHelp: It draws a random station map. There is no gameplay.
